description: Tier-1 <each> per-row if= REACTIVE unmount (SPEC §17.1) — THE half broken today. Both rows start on:true (visible). Clicking Alice's .hide maps @rows flipping id=1's on false; the per-item effect swaps her <li> for a comment placeholder in place, so her row is STRUCTURALLY removed (count 2 -> 1), Bob keeps his identity (keyed).
rationale: §17.1 a per-row if= that flips true->false removes the element from the DOM. The create-time-only gate at emit-each.ts left the row present forever; the swap-in-place tracked node (element <-> comment, key transplanted) makes the flip observable. Survivor id=2 pins keyed reconcile through the swap.
